nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: one says the cleanser leaves skin still feeling oily and not clean, while another with oily/sensitive skin found it gentle and felt it reduced breakouts.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally find it hydrating and non-stripping, though one notes it isn't effective at removing makeup and dislikes the scent.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it cleanses without leaving skin dry or tight and describe it as calming, with one noting no greasy film left behind.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most consistently report no stinging, burning, or irritation, describing it as calming and gentle, including on compromised or barrier-stripped skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s reports the cleanser does not break her out, unlike many other products she has tried.

concerns.aging: One reviewer, describing herself as 40, reports the product does not break her out, which she highlights as notable for her skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser hydrates and leaves skin soft rather than tight or stripped; one reviewer with dry skin says she saw no noticeable difference in moisture level.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with reactive or inflamed skin report the cleanser is soothing and does not leave skin irritated or angry afterward.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a stripped barrier (post-peel) reports the cleanser does not further dehydrate or anger the skin; another with severe psoriasis reports it calms associated skin side effects.
concerns.spots: One postpartum reviewer reports the product made her hormonal breakouts slightly worse despite liking it otherwise; another reviewer says it seems to break her out; several others report no breakouts and even a reduction in clogged pores.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports it does not cause breakouts and pairs well with an acne wash, while a couple of other reviewers separately mention the product making their skin break out more.
concerns.oiliness: One oily-skin reviewer reports the cleanser removes oiliness from the day without over-drying, while another with oily skin reports her face still feels oily afterward and not fully clean.

aspects.libelle: Pump bottle easy and economical to use
No foaming lather, unfamiliar cleanse feel

extraits.texte: I have dry skin and live in a very dry climate so I'm always on the hunt for products that will hydrate without clogging pores or cause other issues. I don't find this is the most effective cleanser when I'm wearing makeup so I tend to stick to using this when I'm wearing little to no makeup. However, the biggest con to this is the smell. At first, it just smells somewhat floral but as I've continued to use it (and I even asked my husband to make sure it wasn't just me), it smells like a port-a-potty. I don't think I would repurchase because of that alone. If it had another scent profile, I would consider purchasing when this runs out.

extraits.titre: Gentle, but didn't leave me feeling clean
extraits.texte: I have never used a milk cleanser before, so was excited to try this out and love other things I've used from this brand before. The consistency is very milky and it did feel very gentle on my skin. I do have oily skin though so unfortunately this just didn't leave me feeling very clean. My skin still felt oily afterwards, so I would probably only opt to use this is I was planning on double cleansing. The bottle is nice and I love the simplicity of this brands packaging, it looks aesthetic on a shelf.

I actually really like the product sadly i didn't consider the fact that im postpartum and my hormones are crazy right now so im already breaking out and this has been kinda making it a little bit worse I do use it twice a week now though along with my acne wash and it's helping alot I also will say I LOVEEE how soft and clean it makes my skin look

I have combination skin, and I'm always looking for a cleanser that can remove makeup and sunscreen without leaving my skin feeling dry or tight. I've been using the Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Gentle Cleansing Milk as the first step in my evening routine, and I really like how gentle it feels on my skin. The texture is creamy and lightweight, and it spreads easily as I massage it over my face. It does a great job of dissolving my sunscreen, makeup, and daily impurities, but my skin still feels soft and comfortable after rinsing instead of stripped or squeaky clean. I especially like that it doesn't leave a greasy film behind. I also appreciate the ingredients, especially Centella Asiatica, ceramides, and multiple types of hyaluronic acid. After cleansing, my skin feels hydrated and calm, which is especially nice for my combination skin. I haven't experienced any irritation or dryness while using it. This cleansing milk has been a really nice addition to my routine. If you prefer a gentle first step cleanser that removes makeup and sunscreen while keeping your skin feeling soft and hydrated, I would definitely recommend giving this one a try. I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review.

When my skin is angry at me (barrier stripped, after a peel etc) this is such a nice, gentle but still effective cleanser. I dont wear makeup so I cant speak to that but it takes care of lightweight sunscreens. I have dehydrated but oily/combination skin that is acne and congestion prone. This cleanser doesnt dehydrate further, doesnt anger my skin barrier more and it doesnt break me out. I plan to continue to keep this on hand.

I've been trying this for a while and so far I do like it . It doesn't break me out which is big for me I'm 40 and a lot of stuff I've found seems to not work for my skin. This leaves soft feel after I rinse it off . I've used it on a dry face and wet face feels the same. If you are looking for something gentle and no fragrance this might work for you .

I use this product with severe psoriasis and it helps with my not so pretty side effects! Calms and soothes my skin unlike anything I have ever tried! The perfect cleanser for me! Finally a holy grail product I will keep in my routine forever!
